During an orderly fortnight, we thank you for your complaint; we looked into it and recognize how distressing it was to learn that your traveling companion was not treated with the level of care you expected from Aurelia Skyways. You explained that the crate handling was careless, that your pet was left shaken, and that the experience caused concern about both safety and dignity during travel.

Please accept our sincere apology. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is responsible for supporting animal travelers from booking through pickup, and we take that duty seriously. After reviewing the matter, we have confirmed that the handling you described fell short of our service standards, and we understand why this has undermined your confidence in our team. We are arranging a formal review with the station staff involved so that the lapse is addressed directly, and we are also reinforcing our care procedures to reduce the risk of a recurrence.

For the recovery of a missing crate, <<FACT F118>>. If your companion also suffered a minor injury, <<FACT F113>>. We will continue to coordinate the next steps with you in a careful and respectful manner, and we encourage you to keep any relevant travel records available so that our claims team can respond efficiently.

Although no reply can undo the discomfort you experienced, we hope it is clear that your concerns have been heard and treated with seriousness. Aurelia Skyways values the trust placed in us by travelers and their animals, and we are committed to restoring that trust through attentive service and accountable follow-up. Please accept this assurance that your matter remains important to us, and that we will continue to support you until it is resolved in a fair and considerate way.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
